Subject: Development alignment and proposed short-term plan

Hi Monica / Laura / Karthik,

I wanted to loop you in early — I've had a recurring set of missed deliverables and quality issues with Dylan over the last two quarters. Before we consider formal escalation, I'd like to put a short, documented coaching approach in place so expectations and supports are clear.

High-level proposal (attached: coaching-summary-draft.docx):
- 30-day focused plan with 3 measurable outcomes (timely PRs, ownership of one feature area, improvement in test coverage/QA defects).
- Weekly 1:1 checkpoints + written weekly status notes from Dylan.
- Pairing/mentorship schedule (2x/week) with a senior engineer.
- Clear criteria for next-step review at 30 days.

Two asks from People Ops and leadership:
1) Monica — can you confirm any mandatory process steps and language we should include so this remains informal but documented?
2) Laura / Karthik — are you comfortable with this approach and the escalation criteria I outlined?

This is intended as a transparent path to get Dylan back on track; I will forward the plan to Dylan once we align on wording.

Thanks,
Rohan

Thanks for the summary and for bringing this up early, Rohan. I reviewed your draft and attached the standard Pre-PIP guidance we use internally (attached). A few notes:

- Keep language factual and outcome-focused (dates, deliverables, measurable targets). Avoid speculative wording.
- Include a short section on supports (mentorship, reduced scope where appropriate, learning resources).
- Include a private copy for HR to retain; don’t share the HR copy in the initial 1:1.
- Document 1:1 outcomes (we recommend a short template with Date / Action / Owner / Evidence).

I made inline suggestions in your draft. Once you send to Dylan, please copy People Ops and mark the email as confidential.

Attachment: prepip-guidelines.pdf

Monica Patel
Senior People Partner, Redwood Inference

Dylan — following up on our 1:1 from last week. I want to be direct and make sure you have explicit expectations and supports for the next 30 days. Monica from People Ops is copied here to make sure we follow our process.

What I observed (examples):
- Multiple ship slips on the Search indexing work in Q2 (PRs merged late, several rework cycles).
- Regressions appeared in two recent releases that traced back to missed unit tests.

30-day objectives (measurable):
1) Deliver the Search indexing patch by EOM Aug 31 with no regressions related to prior defects (owner: Dylan).
2) Reduce PR review turnaround to <48 hours for your assigned tickets (owner: Dylan + mentor).
3) Add or stabilize 80% unit coverage for the affected module (owner: Dylan).

Supports offered:
- Pairing sessions with Priya (senior eng) twice weekly; schedule to be set this week.
- Weekly 1:1 with me (30 min) + brief end-of-week update email from you listing progress and blockers.
- Access to a focused test-writing workshop (we'll reserve a 2-hour slot next week).

Evaluation and next steps:
- We will track the three measurable outcomes above. If progress is insufficient after 30 days, we will convene with People Ops to discuss next steps (which may include formal performance improvement steps).

Please confirm you understand these objectives and whether you want adjustments. We will set the first checkpoint for next Monday at 10am.

Thanks — I want to make sure you have the support to succeed here.

Rohan
